title: Men Wide Toe Box Mesh Lace Up Walking Shoes Curved Side Pattern PU Outsole Pull Tabs Wholesale EU 39-46
highlights:
Wide toe-box mesh lace-up walking shoes with a curved side pattern, pull tabs and PU outsole.

Room for the forefoot: The wider toe design gives the toes more space at the front of the shoe for everyday walking.

Adjustable instep fit: The front laces let the wearer loosen the opening for entry and set the tension over the foot.

A grip for entry: The pull loop provides a place to hold the shoe while guiding the foot into the opening.
